name: Teniloxazine
summary: Teniloxazine (Lucelan, Metatone), also known as sufoxazine and sulfoxazine, is a drug which is marketed in Japan. Though initially investigated as a neuroprotective and nootropic agent for the treatment of cerebrovascular insufficiency in the 1980s, it was ultimately developed and approved as an antidepressant instead.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a potent norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor, with fair selectivity over the serotonin and dopamine transporters, and also behaves as an antagonist of the 5-HT2A receptor.

uses.text: Teniloxazine (Lucelan, Metatone), also known as sufoxazine and sulfoxazine, is a drug which is marketed in Japan. Though initially investigated as a neuroprotective and nootropic agent for the treatment of cerebrovascular insufficiency in the 1980s, it was ultimately developed and approved as an antidepressant instead.

sideEffects.en: Little detail has been published. Drugs of its type, noradrenaline reuptake inhibitors, can cause dry mouth, sweating, constipation, a raised heart rate and trouble sleeping.
sideEffects.zh: 已發表的細節很少。同類的正腎上腺素再回收抑制劑可能造成口乾、出汗、便秘、心跳加快與失眠。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已发表的细节很少。同类的正肾上腺素再回收抑制剂可能造成口干、出汗、便秘、心跳加快与失眠。

fact.en: It began in the 1980s as a candidate brain-protecting and memory drug for poor blood flow to the brain, but ended up approved in Japan as an antidepressant.
fact.zh: Teniloxazine在1980年代原本是作為改善腦部血流不足的腦保護與記憶藥物候選，最後卻在日本被核准作為抗憂鬱藥。
fact.zhHans: Teniloxazine在1980年代原本是作为改善脑部血流不足的脑保护与记忆药物候选，最后却在日本被核准作为抗忧郁药。
